name: 氷華の雪化粧／Snow Veil
detailed_description:
Ice Flowers' Snow Adornment

A tale of sin and atonement. A visual novel playable in approximately 2 hours.

Synopsis

No winter lasts forever. Yet, that is no consolation. There are people who can only continue breathing by clinging to their pain.

High school student Haruto Tsukishima is continually tormented by his sense of guilt. It all began on that winter day when he hurt his precious childhood friend, Mio Yukimura. The sensation of pushing her onto the hard, icy ground still aches in his hands. He took everything from her. He ruined her life. Yet, he could never bring himself to confess the truth. He continued to lie, saying it was an accident, a "tragedy"—

One day, a voice calls out from behind him, "Could you please show me the way?" It was an encounter with a ghost. A miraculous recovery. Due to the shock of hitting her head, Mio had lost her memory.

"I must make her happy."

Haruto's days of atonement begin, as he wears the mask of lies—

How to Play

This game works like a typical visual novel. Click to advance messages, and use buttons to change settings or check the backlog.

*Note: The setting of this story is original and has no connection to any specific incidents, individuals, religions, or organizations.

  • Endings: 1 type

  • Estimated play time: 2 hours

  • Controls: Mouse

  • Save function: Available

Streaming Guidelines

  • About Streaming and Let's Play Videos

    • No prior notification is required for streaming the game or creating and posting Let's Play videos.

    • You are free to create content regardless of monetization.

  • Precautions

    • Please refrain from defaming or making aggressive comments toward others.

    • Please be respectful toward the game content and other players.

Special Note

Character voices were created using "Niji Voice."
